note: Shipped reference profile (governance plane). A regulated organization enforcing controls through provider-native systems — repository, CI, deployment, admission, identity, cloud — without agent hooks or lifecycle commands. Selectable as --profile external-enforcement-only-profile. Validated by validate-reference-profiles.ts against the governance profile contract; capabilities resolve against the capability registry.
scope: Governance guarantees delivered by external systems of record rather than in-session controls.
applicability: Regulated organization whose enforcement authority lives in CI, deployment, and provider systems.

facetRequirements.lifecycle: No workflow plane; external systems own the enforced lifecycle gates.
facetRequirements.governance: Supply-chain and provenance policies enforced by external authorities with declared applicability and failure behavior.
facetRequirements.executor: External and human executors preserve the native subject, revision, policy version, and decision.
facetRequirements.enforcement: Mandatory intents bind to external enforcement points whose guarantees are authoritative only for their declared subject and scope.
facetRequirements.data: Data handling and residency are enforced by the provider systems, not by in-session controls.
facetRequirements.telemetry: Evidence is consumed from external systems by reference; the plane does not re-derive it.
facetRequirements.distribution: Modules are provider-native; provenance and pinning are verified before trust.

failureBehavior: An unavailable or unsupported external enforcement point fails visibly rather than implying integrated coverage.
absenceReport: Agent hooks and lifecycle commands are optional; only external enforcement guarantees are claimed.
